explication: Memori is a persistent-memory SDK and agent integration suite. In the principal workflow, an application’s LLM interaction is captured and attributed, augmented into structured memories, and persisted; later requests retrieve relevant memories for recall or prompt injection. The Python and TypeScript packages expose parallel SDK surfaces, with the TypeScript native engine delegating storage operations through its storage manager. README capabilities also include explicit agent recall, OpenClaw and Hermes integrations, MCP access, and BYODB. Some integration wiring is documented rather than sampled, so those relationships are shown only at the documented boundary.
